From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Kate Burke <kate.burke@acme.com>

Subject: Production gate acceptance: VPC governance review + observability sign-off

Team / Kate,

We're less than 24 hours from the targeted production transition window for ACME's private VPC deployment. Before we open the gate I want a concise acceptance note that covers three areas: governance controls, network reachability, and an initial observability pass (latency, error budget, and cache warm-up).

Attached you'll find the VPC governance checklist we've been iterating on. Key asks for today: 
- Hannah: confirm ACLs and routing policies match the signed network diagram (sections 2-4).
- Markus: run and paste the short smoke test results (token latency percentiles and end-to-end request success) back to this thread.
- Laura: confirm runbook playback readiness and escalation contacts are visible in the console.
- Naomi: verify audit log export path and retention policy are enabled for customer-managed KMS.

Kate / OpsOps: please confirm the agreed maintenance window (start + end) and whether you'll be applying any last-minute firewall changes from your side.

I'll coordinate the rollback thresholds and hold the final green light until we get the above confirmations. If anything looks risky, call it out — prefer a short delay vs. a noisy cutover.

Attachments: vpc-governance-checklist.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0189

- ACLs: verified against diagram v4.2, no unexpected wide rules (internal notes: 10.0.0.0/8 allowed only on management plane).

- Minor: one security group had a 0.0.0.0/0 rule on port 9090 (prometheus exporter) — patched and pushed. Please see line items 7-9 in checklist.

OpsOps: did you apply the inbound firewall rule for the application healthcheck? If yes, confirm the start/finish time so we can align smoke timing.

Date: Sat, 09 Jan 2027 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production gate acceptance: VPC governance review + observability sign-off

Quick playback from the smoke run I executed against the pre-prod mirror (replicating the production routing):
- End-to-end success rate: 99.87% over 15m (see attached CSV). Failures were transient TLS handshake timeouts on 3 of 1200 requests; retry budget handled them.
- Token generation p50/p95/p99: 42ms / 128ms / 502ms. Those p99 spikes correlate with cold KV-cache misses that warmed after 3 requests.
- CPU/GPU: steady-state utilization within expected band (GPU % and mem stable).
- Observability checks: APM traces are linked; latency SLO: currently at 99.2% under 200ms, which is within the acceptable threshold for this partner as per contract.

Recommendation: green light provided for the gate. Marking readiness to execute the runbook at start of window. If ACME or OpsOps see any objections, flag now — otherwise we'll execute as planned and post the full run artifacts to the dashboard.

Attachments: smoke-results-20270109.csv, obs-sample-screenshots.zip

Markus Klein
Head of Platform Reliability, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
